question: Which country was ranked 101st in the Global Hunger Index 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​The global hunger index is defined as a term for monitoring whether countries are achieving hunger-related SDGs.**
 
• It is also used for international ranking.
 
• The **index **is released by two companies namely **Concern Worldwide and Welthungerhilfe in **every **October.**
 
• **The Hunger Index which measures**** **every country's performance based on four component indicators.
 
• They are **undernourishment, child wasting, child stunting and child mortality.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Global Hunger Index 2021**

 
• Pakistan – 92
 
• Sri Lanka – 65
 
• Nepal – 76
 
• Bangladesh – 76

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **In the 2022 Global Hunger Index, India ranks 107th out of 121 countries. **
